content.text: Adam Sandler's Kids, Sadie & Sunny, Have Been in Over 20 Movies Each - Full List Revealed!Happy Gilmore 2 is now streaming on Netflix and Adam Sandler made it a family affair with his wife Jackie and their daughters Sadie and Sunny all featured in the film.In the new film, Sunny plays the role of Happy’s daughter Vienna Gilmore while Jackie and Sadie both have cameos.Adam and Jackie, who met on the set of his 1999 movie Big Daddy, got married in Malibu in June 2003.
